reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
